reviews.review:
I bet the game is actually fun past the first boss but after about several solo runs where i think my build is probably the best it could possibly be, i just die each and every time.
The style is pretty good and i like the look of the characters but gameplaywise it feels like a Pre-Pre-alpha version of a game way out from release, the camera sucks and using any sort of weapon feels clunky.
The difficulty feels WAY too arbitrary to the point where i feel like i won't be able to to get to stage 2 until i spend 15 hours getting enough currency for upgrades in the camp just from farming the first stage.
It feels like the game was balanced around groups of friends but mine have no interest in it, and the fact the game barely breaks above 200 daily players i can barely find public matches and no one joins mine when i have mine set to public.
Maybe it'll get better down the line but it feels like the entire game needs a rebalancing
reviews.developer_response: Hey Woltiv, thanks for the review. Your callouts are all fair. The good news is that on August 11, we are releasing a massive update to the game that should address a lot of your concerns. We are adjust balance on all difficulties and with all enemies. We are doubling the weapon count, adding 12 new ones, that should feel pretty responsive. And we are introducing more ways to make intentional builds. As for public matches, games only show up here if they have not yet left for the first camp and if you are in a good ping range. We expect more people to be playing once the update drops and you should be able to find a match there. If not, head to our discord.gg/LORT and the #LFG channel. Hope you'll check out the update!

reviews.review:
Let's be honest here. I love indie games. This game however, needs way too much work. It is a soulless copy of Risk of Rain 2 and lacks actual depth. I know I'm being harsh but from the reviews I've seen, no one is willing to be honest. The characters aren't anything special and it genuinely feels that the abilities are secondary. For a game with so much going on in battles, why is there no item to expand ability size? The end game boss is just awful. It's just a mesh of every boss + sponge. The gimmick of taking your items is just a copy of ROR2 as well. Anyone who actually enjoys rouguelikes would know this game needs so much more. Why even release at this time? 

That being said, I enjoyed it for the first 20 minutes and for some reason the beta was much more fun. This game needs much more polishing and really needs to fix it's identity. People need to stop glazing indie games just to support the hobby.
reviews.developer_response: Hey Mentos. Thanks for the review. Heard on your feedback. While I am not sure it will address all of your feedback, we have a massive update coming out on August 11. We are overhauling systems, adding new quests, characters, doubling the weapon count, fixing a lot of pain points, and more. Hope you will check it out and let us know what you think.

Play Risk of Rain 2, feels better and this kinda feels like a knock off clone that didn't hit its mark.
